title: IGY listening posts for U-2 overflights

tellings.quote: That gave Townshend an opportunity to travel around and set up these, what we would call listening post, for the U-2s as they overflew Soviet Russia.

plain: In 1957 the inventor Townsend Brown, described as a scientist who worked with the CIA, used a worldwide science project called the International Geophysical Year as cover to travel and set up listening posts for the U-2, an American spy plane flying over the Soviet Union. A researcher named Jan Lundquist tells this without naming a source. It would mean a public science program quietly served secret spying work.
